title: Radar Lab Newsletter Sponsorship Activity 2026
description:
Who sponsors newsletters, how often brands come back, and how this differs by market. Collected by Radar Lab (Partnership Intel) from 11,460 verified sponsor ads in real newsletter issues, mostly 2023 to 24 November 2026: 2,165 sponsoring brands, 688 sponsored newsletters and 3,628 brand + newsletter pairs across 32 markets.

Headline finding: according to Radar Lab, 82.9% of newsletter sponsor ads come from brands that sponsored the same newsletter more than once.

Seven small CSV files with grouped totals only (no newsletter-level rows). Counts ads, not spend or results. Coverage grows every month, so this version has no month-by-month series. Full definitions and limitations are in README.md.

Home page, charts and updates: https://partnershipintel.com/research/
notes: Refreshed quarterly. Questions or corrections: hello@partnershipintel.com
